c06_municipios.sql: select count(*),count(distinct s.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D),count(QT_POPULACAO),sum(QT_POPULACAO) from socioeconomico s join municipios m using(CO_MUNICIPIO_6D) where NU_ANO=2019 and SG_UF='CE'

c08_cobertura.sql: select distinct NU_ANO from socioeconomico order by 1

c11_atendimento.sql: select count(*) from internacao where year(DT_INTER)=2021 and MUNIC_RES=430460 and CNES in (select CNES from hospital where MUNIC_MOV=431490)

c12_procedimentos.sql: select count(distinct p.N_AIH),count(*) from internacao_procedimento p join internacao i using(N_AIH) where PROC_REA='0411010034' and i.DT_INTER between '2023-04-01' and '2023-04-30'

c19_dias.sql: select dayname(DT_INTER),count(*) as n from internacao i join municipios m on m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D=i.MUNIC_RES where SG_UF='PA' and year(DT_INTER)=2019 group by 1 order by n desc

c24_corte.sql: select DIAG_PRINC,count(*),avg(DIAS_PERM) as x from internacao where year(DT_INTER)=2021 and DIAG_PRINC is not null group by 1 having count(*)>5000 order by x desc,1 limit 4

c26_componentes.sql: select (select count(*) from internacao where MUNIC_RES=420540 and year(DT_INTER)=2019) as aiHs, QT_POPULACAO from socioeconomico where CO_MUNICIPIO_6D=420540 and NU_ANO=2019

c32_taxas.sql: select year(DT_INTER),round(100*avg(MORTE::int),2) from internacao i join municipios m on m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D=i.MUNIC_RES where SG_UF='RS' and year(DT_INTER) in(2019,2020) group by 1 order by 1
